title: From Non-Convex Self-Concordant Regularization to Scalable Quasi-Newton Training of PINNs
abstract: arXiv:2608.04206v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often require high-accuracy quasi-Newton refinement to obtain reliable partial differential equation solutions, but their residual objectives can exhibit indefinite, nearly singular, and poorly scaled local curvature. Regularized quasi-Newton methods provide established mechanisms for stabilizing secant models, while self-concordant methods provide local-metric rules for curvature-dependent step selection. Building on these two lines of work, we propose SCORE, a self-concordance-inspired quasi-Newton method with decrement-coupled shifted secant geometry for PINN training. Its distinguishing mechanism is that a single quasi-Newton decrement computed from the learned inverse metric jointly determines a strong-Wolfe-tested candidate step and an adaptive shift used to define the next secant geometry. translated_title: 从非凸自和谐正则化到可扩展的准牛顿训练物理信息神经网络
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.04206v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：物理信息神经网络（PINNs）通常需要高精度的准牛顿细化以获得可靠的偏微分方程解，但其残差目标可能表现出不定、近似奇异且尺度不良的局部曲率。正则化准牛顿方法提供了稳定割线模型的成熟机制，而自和谐方法则提供了基于曲率的步长选择的局部度量规则。基于这两方面的工作，我们提出了SCORE，一种受自和谐启发的准牛顿方法，具有减量耦合的移位割线几何，用于PINN训练。其独特机制在于，从学习到的逆度量计算出的单一准牛顿减量同时决定了一个经过强沃尔夫检验的候选步长和一个自适应移位，该移位用于定义下一个割线几何。移位位移表示沿接受步长的平均移位度量的作用。
tldr: 本文提出SCORE方法，通过自和谐启发的准牛顿减量联合控制步长选择和割线几何移位，从而提升PINN训练的可扩展性和稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SCORE, a self-concordance-inspired quasi-Newton method that jointly controls step selection and secant geometry shift via a single decrement, enhancing scalability and stability in PINN training.
